title: Singing Glasses

intro.speaker: greta
intro.text: Listen! That's the cathedral bell. The bell-ringer is teaching the children to play tunes, with glasses of water!

intro.speaker: greta
intro.text: Each glass sings a different note, depending on how full it is. Will you fill them to their lines?

steps.speaker: greta
steps.prompt: Fill each glass to its line. Hold the jug over a glass, and let go at the line.

older.prompt: Fill each glass to its line: a quarter, half, three quarters, and full.

feedback.too_full: Oops, over the line! Tap that glass to pour it back.
feedback.all_good: Now tap them: ting, tang, tong! A little tune.

outro.speaker: greta
outro.text: Ting, tang, tong! The bell-ringer says you have a good ear. Music is everywhere, if you listen.

journal_line: I filled singing glasses with water in Bellhaven.
